context.body: Worship, doubt, universal authority, a threefold naming, and continuing presence close the Gospel.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: The risen Jesus claims all authority, sends disciples to all nations, commands baptism in the singular name of Father, Son, and Holy Spirit, and promises presence.
observations.label: Jesus commissions in one shared name: action

observations.body: The disciples worship and some doubt; they receive a teaching and baptizing mission.
observations.label: Jesus commissions in one shared name: response

observations.body: all authority · all nations · name · Father, Son, Holy Spirit · with you
observations.label: Words in Matthew 28:16–20

payload.posture: Read Matthew 28:16–20 as jesus names the father evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The singular “name” gathers three named persons without explaining their relation in later technical terms.
payload.title: Jesus commissions in one shared name
